Fixed with blockIdx.z row tiles; gate_ogroup_gemv now covers M=17,24,33 and fails without the fix.

note_for_executor: N1 is CLOSED and it was a correctness bug, not nondeterminism: rows 16+ of the ogroup output were never written for bs>16, so every prompt of 18+ tokens had garbage in its prefill. The engine is now deterministic — identical sweep points give identical everything. That also means the +/-17% measurement caveat from Finding 60 is GONE for prompts that were hitting it, and single-point measurements are trustworthy again. THE STANDING LESSON: every correctness gate in this project ran at the canonical 6-token prompt, which cannot reach a bs>16 code path, while the sweep prompts (11/15/18/29 tokens) had been running through it for cycles. Gate the shape range the engine spans, not the one the canonical prompt uses. Next: re-derive any ranking that used multi-prompt sweep numbers taken before this fix — they were measuring a partly-garbage prefill.
